from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
import csv, hashlib, io, json, subprocess, sys, time
root = Path('products/services/catalogue-qa')
fixture = root / 'fulfillment'
runtime = root / 'runtime'
procedure = fixture / 'procedure.md'
entry = runtime / 'verify_example.py'
with TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
    work = Path(temp)
    for name in ('transform.py', 'verify.py', 'verify_example.py'):
        (work / name).write_bytes((runtime / name).read_bytes())
    for source, dest in [('synthetic-v.csv', 'v.csv'), ('synthetic-i.csv', 'i.csv'), ('synthetic-ours.csv', 'pass.csv')]:
        (work / dest).write_bytes((fixture / source).read_bytes())
    reader = csv.DictReader(io.StringIO((work / 'pass.csv').read_text()))
    rows = list(reader)
    sku = 'SYN-B-BL-XXL'
    matches = [row for row in rows if row['SKU'] == sku]
    assert len(matches) == 1
    row = matches[0]
    row.update({'Barcodes': '0000000000000', 'Variant image URL': 'https://example.invalid/fictional-variant.png'})
    with (work / 'fail.csv').open('w', newline='') as handle:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=reader.fieldnames)
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)
    results = []
    for candidate, expected_exit in [('pass.csv', 0), ('fail.csv', 1)]:
        command = [sys.executable, 'verify_example.py', 'v.csv', 'i.csv', candidate]
        start = time.monotonic()
        process = subprocess.run(command, cwd=work, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
        results.append({'argv': command, 'expected_exit': expected_exit, 'exit': process.returncode, 'stdout': process.stdout, 'stderr': process.stderr, 'elapsed_seconds': time.monotonic() - start, 'produced_rows_sha256': hashlib.sha256((work / candidate).read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
receipt = {'synthetic': True, 'verifier_sha256': hashlib.sha256(entry.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'documented_invocations': [line for line in procedure.read_text().splitlines() if 'verify_example.py' in line], 'synthetic_mutation': {'sku': sku, 'record_after_header': rows.index(row) + 1, 'fields': ['Barcodes', 'Variant image URL']}, 'runs': results, 'expected_exit_codes_matched': all(result['exit'] == result['expected_exit'] for result in results), 'manual_report_preparation_seconds': None}
output = root / 'fixed-price-trial' / 'director-verifier-controls.json'
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
print(output.read_text())

Run the documented verifier on the same passing and failing inputs to determine what the CAD 60 report can promise and which findings require manual row location.
